layer_stack — GFX2D composite op

• Data kinds: table → rgba

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.layer_stack(layers) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.layer_stack(layers), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("layer_stack"))

उपयोग

z-क्रम वाली rgba layer की सूची को composite करता है, सबसे नीचे वाली पहले।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Each layer is a dict:

{"image": rgba, "mode": str = "normal", "opacity": float = 1.0}

and the W3C rule for a blend mode against a *partially transparent* backdrop is used — the blend function is weighted by the backdrop's own alpha, Cs' = (1 - a_b) Cs + a_b B(Cb, Cs) — so a layer over empty space keeps its own colour whatever the mode. The result is straight-alpha rgba.

All layers must share one shape; see alpha_composite on why.

Raises ValueError: empty list, more than MAX_LAYERS, a non-dict entry, an unknown key, mismatched shapes.
